issue: The winget/full Paragon build can prompt for activation immediately after installation.
change: The Windows driver helper now downloads and installs the official Paragon HFS+ trial MSI instead of relying on winget.
installer_behavior: downloads to TEMP, verifies SHA-256, runs msiexec /passive /norestart, then asks for a reboot
existing_installation: warns the user and opens Settings > Apps so a full/winget build can be removed first
